copied_files.modification: path-routing only: ARCHIVE_DIR -> PHM2010_ROOT env var (default data/PHM2010/raw/); WINDOW_DIR -> B7_WINDOW_CACHE_DIR env var (default data/PHM2010/cache/dynamic_gin_tgp/windows/). Renamed build_all_windows_cache->build_windows_cache, dropped the unused Protocol-A-only manifest helpers (this repo's formal protocol is Protocol B only). No change to trim/portion/window-extraction math.

Vendored (previously live-imported via baselines/dynamic_gin_tgp/data/label_utils.py's sys.path insert of 代码/). define_condition_relative_stages: identical formula/thresholds, removed the hardcoded DIR_RESULT diagnostic CSV write (now a pure function). split_grouped_lifecycle's hardcoded train={C1,C4}/test={C6} generalized to any (train_conditions, test_condition) via the already-validated condition_split.py::make_split_fn pattern (used for this project's existing frozen D2/D3 results).

Rewritten to the shared MethodAdapter interface (prepare/build_model/train/predict). Training loop (Adam lr/weight_decay/batch_size, ReduceLROnPlateau, early stopping on run-level val acc) and the batch-shuffle-required-for-static-graph fix are preserved unchanged from the original. Metrics/DONE.flag/run_meta writing now delegated to shared/runners/method_adapter.py's base class instead of this method's own save_outputs().

not_copied.reason: 64MB cached preprocessed window .npy files, regenerable from raw signal via code/preprocessing.py::build_windows_cache(); excluded per repo-wide policy on regenerable large caches.

Paper-native sanity-check protocol, not used by this repo's formal D1/D2/D3 comparison table (which only ever used 'Protocol B'). Not ported; see old train.py if ever needed for a future paper-fidelity re-check.

adaptation_notes: Architecture (model.py) and training hyperparameters (config.yaml) are UNCHANGED from the validated published-baseline reproduction. Only task/seed/path routing changed, per task spec section 35. Seed handling: old train.py::run_protocol_b already accepted seed as a proper kwarg (verified against the live file, not assumed) -- this adapter just wires MethodAdapter's self.seed through via shared/utils/seeding.py::seed_everything(), called by the base class immediately before build_model(), matching this repo's isolated-RNG-per-model policy.
checkpoint_note: Historical checkpoint size ~4.4MB (torch.save of state_dict). Never committed to git regardless of size -- **/*.pt and **/*.pth are globally gitignored.
